system.description:
Tarro are a tall, technologically advanced humanoid Species on the verge of extinction. Nearly a century before the Battle of Yavin, the Tarro homeworld was destroyed when its sun exploded with little warning. Tarro survivors living in other systems speculated that a Tarro-built superweapon may have caused the catastrophe, although the truth might never be known.

Only a few hundred Tarro survived the destruction of their home system, and they quickly scattered among the stars. A few joined the ranks of The Rebel Alliance; others sought out reported "Lost Colonies" of Tarro in The Unknown Regions.
